Defeat: Deceiver Trid

Trid pretended to be a prophet, but was soon exposed as a fraud and banished from the Nornir.
After spending many years alone, he disappeared, only to later be found wandering, deprived of his soul.
Trid is now a terrifying creature that lures people in and takes their lives, and must be dealt with.

Trid udawał proroka, lecz wkrótce zdemaskowano go jako oszusta i wygnano spośród Nornirów.

One of the Daeva who took the lead in burying Karas alive.

Now a Karas, Aed must be eliminated.

Był jednym z Daevów, którzy przewodzili grzebaniu Karas żywcem.

Teraz Aed jest Karasem i trzeba go zgładzić.
